fullDescription: Renders the user-profile-overview screen in its default state at the root route and keeps the page-level composition separate from shared profile UI.

Presents a three-column dashboard-home screen with a global header, repository sidebar, prompt composer, feed cards, and a right rail for event and changelog content. Supports the default state through props for user name, search placeholder, repository lists, and changelog items while keeping visible controls interactive with local state for prompt text, repository filtering, feed filtering, and repository scope selection.

shortDescription: Reusable GitHub-style user profile overview screen.
fullDescription: Presents a dark user-profile-overview screen with a global header, repository scope tabs, profile sidebar, pinned repository grid, and yearly contribution activity visualization. Supports the default state through props for selected tab, user details, repository cards, contribution totals, and contribution year while keeping visible controls interactive with local state for the active tab and header search filtering.
